data.body: Consideration: [Implicit shared state] Orchestrator-shared facts load — define cache consistency contract for parallel reviewer batches. Required: facts content is snapshotted at BATCH DISPATCH TIME (not session start, not per-reviewer). All reviewers in a parallel batch receive the SAME snapshot regardless of whether S9 cron or manual regeneration runs mid-session. S2's atomic-write guarantee prevents torn reads but not cross-reviewer divergence within one batch.
